Refresh current heads and coordination; generate multiple alternatives and counterhypotheses; use high-information falsifiers; refresh connectivity, zero-install portability, direct Linux terminal/process execution, low-latency Clay data transformation, visual/image/video transport and audio transport; coordinate Vercel Sandbox batches; treat exact-identity Vercel Sandbox observation as executable source of truth; continue beyond the first green component test while useful authorized work remains; finish by rebuilding/testing the exact one-file EntityOS Clay Computer in Vercel Sandbox when technically possible or by naming its exact blocker and next executable sandbox step.
